product_one_liner.value: Matillion automates data integration and helps data teams build and manage pipelines for AI and analytics at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes an intelligent data integration platform for data teams to build and manage pipelines for AI and analytics at scale. Source: https://www.matillion.com/about-us.

pricing_page.notes: Matillion has a public pricing page describing usage-based pricing. Source: https://www.matillion.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Matillion explicitly names Cisco and DocuSign among enterprises that trust it to move, transform and automate their data, with links to customer success stories. Source: https://www.matillion.com/about-us. | named_customers.0: The about page names Cisco as an enterprise using Matillion and links its success story. | named_customers.1: The about page names DocuSign as an enterprise using Matillion and links its success story.

employee_band.notes: Matillion's company profile lists 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/matillion-limited.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Matillion explicitly describes dual headquarters in Denver and Manchester. Source: https://www.matillion.com/about-us. | hq_country: Matillion describes dual headquarters in Manchester and Denver, corresponding to the United Kingdom and United States respectively. Sources: https://www.matillion.com/about-us and https://www.maia.ai/resources/news/matillion-launches-maia-foundation-on-google-bigquery.

founded_year.notes: The company history says it has empowered data teams since 2011, and the funding profile explicitly identifies 2011 as its founding year. Sources: https://www.matillion.com/about-us and https://indexed.vc/companies/matillion.

eng_blog.notes: Two engineer-authored implementation posts qualify: software engineering interns describe building a pipeline static-analysis reviewer, and software engineer intern Emma Wang describes implementing and deploying the ObServant monitoring system. Sources: https://www.matillion.com/blog/building-the-data-pipeline-quality-reviewer and https://www.matillion.com/blog/bringing-agentic-ai-to-real-time-data-monitoring.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple distinct articles, including client access, job documentation, and groups and permissions. Source: https://docs.matillion.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Data Scientist posting includes an application link and directly satisfies the qualifying-title requirement. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/matillion/bbe33696-3659-4202-8542-6f2ae4d37564.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock; OpenAI ChatGPT; OpenAI for Azure
model_provider.notes: The AI FAQ explicitly names AWS Bedrock, OpenAI's ChatGPT and OpenAI for Azure as integrated third-party AI services. Source: https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/ai-faq.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center publicly claims SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA and GDPR compliance, and PCI DSS 4.0.1 certification. HIPAA and GDPR are included as the requested compliance claims, not represented as independently issued certifications. Source: https://www.matillion.com/trust-center. | compliance_certs.0: The trust center links Matillion's SOC 2 Type II report for 2025–2026. | compliance_certs.1: The trust center explicitly states ISO 27001:2022 compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The trust center explicitly claims HIPAA compliance for protected health information. | compliance_certs.3: The trust center explicitly claims compliance with GDPR obligations. | compliance_certs.4: The trust center explicitly states PCI DSS 4.0.1 certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile classifies the November 8, 2022 investment as Series E. Matillion's announcement describes strategic venture funding without specifying a series. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/matillion/__gxM7VenvJ_pkCZI1EjrWtkwMSON06TuUxyndEeFNxKU. | funding_date: The funding profile identifies November 8, 2022 as the latest round, matching the dated Databricks investment announcement; this becomes 2022-11. Sources: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/matillion/__gxM7VenvJ_pkCZI1EjrWtkwMSON06TuUxyndEeFNxKU and https://www.matillion.com/news/databricks-ventures-invests-in-matillion. | funding_amount_usd: The latest funding entry, dated November 8, 2022, lists an undisclosed amount; therefore no USD amount can be supplied. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/matillion/__gxM7VenvJ_pkCZI1EjrWtkwMSON06TuUxyndEeFNxKU.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded investment was announced November 8, 2022, before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025. Sources: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/matillion/__gxM7VenvJ_pkCZI1EjrWtkwMSON06TuUxyndEeFNxKU and https://www.matillion.com/news/databricks-ventures-invests-in-matillion.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Account Executive – Growth posting for Denver includes an application link. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/matillion/3d0ad5e8-6057-4755-99f3-b1d730c3bdcf.

launched_6mo.notes: Matillion announced general availability of Maia Foundation on Google BigQuery on July 8, 2026, within the requested six-month window. Source: https://www.maia.ai/resources/news/matillion-launches-maia-foundation-on-google-bigquery.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 4, 2026, Matillion announced Girish Pancha as CEO and Sanjay Krishnamurthi as Chief Development Officer, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://www.matillion.com/news/matillion-unveils-new-ceo.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Matillion SDR posting explicitly identifies its technology stack as Gong, Salesforce and LinkedIn Navigator. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/matillion/541f0ba9-8d19-41a9-90fe-f2184fabf4d7. | crm_stack_signal.0: The SDR posting explicitly names Gong in Matillion's technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.1: The SDR posting explicitly names Salesforce in Matillion's technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.2: The SDR posting explicitly names LinkedIn Navigator in Matillion's technology stack.
